emma_ops: Noticed sudden inlet-temp spike on FRA-pod-7, fans ramped to 100% and three H200s tripped. Pod lost ~22% throughput.
jonathan_procurement: Reached out to VendorPartner. They admit a small batch of H200s shipped with incorrect fan firmware; replacements available. Standard lead time 8-12 business days. Expedited air issuance 48-72h with +5% expedite surcharge.
rachel_sre: Short mitigations: (1) redistribute critical shards to AMS and parity-reduce lower-priority models, (2) enable `runtime.token_watermark=0.9` to reduce tail regen risk. Both will increase cost but avoid hard SLA misses.
oliver_logistics: VendorPartner RMA checklist: serials, ambient temp log, depot photos (top, bottom, rear), and `dmesg` snippet. They will not release loaners unless we accept a temporary loaner agreement.
vendor_partner: Confirming: we can issue loaners (1:1) for expedited swaps for up to 10 days. Require signed LOA and manifest upload. AWB can be sent same day after docs.
emma_ops: We have two enterprise customers on EU-low-latency contracts. Recommend expedite + loaners to avoid credits. Jonathan, cost approval?
jonathan_procurement: Draft PO: PO-9022. Cost estimate: unit expedite surcharge 5% (~€4,500 total), express handling €950, prepaid return shipment €350. Recommend charge to cost center `infra-eu-critical`. Need finance sign-off.
rachel_sre: If we accept loaners, note warranty stays on original units; ensure we tag loaners in fleet inventory to prevent accidental decommissioning. I'll add health-check hooks.
oliver_logistics: Depot team can collect serials and logs now. Use photo checklist: `serial, top_label, fan_label, temp_log, packing_damage`. Upload to vendor portal and cc ops@redwood.ai.
vendorbot: Provisional AWB: VP-EU-445566 scheduled pickup 2026-04-02 07:00 UTC. MAWB pending.
emma_ops: Call: decision A = expedite+loaners (+5% + handling) or B = wait for sea replacements (10-14 days) with partial vendor credit (-2%). Thoughts?
jonathan_procurement: Recommend A given customer SLAs. I'll request the LOA and payment terms. Tagging leadership for quick sign-off.
rachel_sre: I'll schedule `runtime.token_watermark` change at 23:30 CET and monitor p99. Rollback threshold: 10% error spike or p99 > 320ms.
oliver_logistics: Once LOA signed, we'll upload manifest and request AWB release. Depot to pre-allocate inbound bay.
emma_ops: Ok proceeding with A pending finance. Jonathan please attach PO + LOA here when done. I'll update incident and customer comms.
jonathan_procurement: PO-9022 created and submitted for approval. Looping in @marco_finance for rapid sign-off.
vendor_partner: LOA draft uploaded to portal. Once signed we'll issue loaner AWB within 6-12h.
vendorbot: Note: Loaner pickup contingent on manifest acceptance. Tracking stub VP-EU-445566 to follow.
emma_ops: Thanks all. Actions: jonathan (PO + LOA), oliver (manifest upload + depot slot), rachel (runtime change), emma (customer comms). Update this thread with AWB and finance sign-off timestamps.
